sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study

currentDecision.reason: The storage and destruction plan is defined as a pre-acquisition control. It has not been executed, no NHATS files are present, no access log exists and no download or extraction is authorized.

storageBoundary.repositoryPolicy: No raw NHATS, raw NSOC, sensitive NHATS, restricted NHATS, row-level derived data, credentials, cookies, tokens or death-date fields may be stored in this repository.
allowedRepositoryArtifacts: hashes of local non-public evidence where sharing is allowed

requiredSteps.description: Stop extraction, export and model runs until the inventory is reconciled.
Match every file, working extract and derived row-level artifact to the local inventory.
Delete or securely wipe governed copies according to local platform capability and source conditions.
Retain only aggregate, non-disclosive outputs that pass disclosure and source-condition review.
Record timestamp, file family, hash where allowed, action, reviewer and remaining aggregate artifacts outside the public repository.
Require second reviewer confirmation before any public aggregate artifact remains.

allowedAiInputs: synthetic examples created without row-level NHATS or NSOC data
aggregate non-disclosive outputs that pass disclosure review
prohibitedActions: download NHATS or NSOC files before every acquisition-readiness gate is ready
place raw NHATS or NSOC files in this repository
place row-level derived NHATS or NSOC extracts in this repository
store NHATS credentials, cookies or tokens in this repository
upload raw or row-level NHATS or NSOC data to public LLMs or AI platforms
export small cells or unsuppressed sensitive tabulations
write extraction scripts before exact fields, file tiers, survey design and disclosure gates pass
claim calibration, validation, intervention effect or individual prediction before governed cohort diagnostics exist

readinessImpact.whyPartial: A plan exists and is machine-audited, but it has not been executed, no controlled workspace is provisioned, no access log exists and no destruction run has been tested.

nextWork: Record NHATS registration status metadata outside the public repository.
Create the controlled workspace outside the repository and record only non-sensitive aliases here.
Initialize an access and inventory log outside the repository before any download.
Run a dry destruction drill on synthetic files before governed NHATS files are acquired.
Keep acquisition status at cannot-extract-yet until registration, file tier, Colectica, survey design, endpoint and disclosure gates are ready.
